about: Golden set for the decision-conflict check (decision_conflict_check@vN, rag-service). One piece of writing per case, the confirmed decisions retrieval would put in front of the judge, and which of them (1-based) the writing contradicts or reopens, or null. Categories: contradicts and reopens are positives; supports (agrees with the decision), related (same topic, compatible or different scope) and unrelated are negatives. A false alarm interrupts someone at work, so the false positive rate is the headline gate.
